text:
Rhea M: Quick follow-up from the recent postmortem: recurring KV warm failures during burst windows. Need owners for runbook edits, exact triage commands, and escalation timing.

Tom B: I'll take the triage/playbook section. Will add a "first 5 min" checklist and short commands. Aim to PR in 48h.

Asha (SRE): I'll own escalation rules and alert ticket. Proposal: page oncall-primary if p95 > 2s for 3m; if no ack in 4m escalate to secondary and DM infra leads.

Devops Eli: I'll handle config remediation (auto-shrink batch_size when cold_start_rate > 2x). Need 10 business days to test on staging.

Tom B: Commands to include (keeping minimal):
```
# check latest kv errors
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-runtime --tail=200 | grep -i kv_cache
# kv warm metric
kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_hit_rate
```
Also add a safe non-destructive sanity check before flush.

Asha (SRE): I'll open ticket INC-2040-ESCL and update runbook with Slack paging message text. Will also change the alert window in staging.

Infra-Bot: Reminder: follow-ups due in tracker by 2026-04-05.

Rhea M: Action list recap:
- Triage checklist + commands: Tom B 1 2026-03-30 (PR)
- Escalation rule + alert ticket: Asha (SRE) 1 2026-03-28 (INC-2040-ESCL)
- Config remediation (batch_size logic + tests): Devops Eli 1 2026-04-10

Tom B: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runbooks/pulls/115 including checklist and commands.

Asha (SRE): Ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2040-ESCL created.

Rhea M: Thanks — please paste any follow-up links here and mark the incident tracker when items are merged.
